comment: Which frame of a hero's sprite sheet is which pose. 'default' was measured in the original (Caramon; Tanis, Goldmoon, Raistlin, Riverwind, Laurana, Flint and Tasslehoff have the same 34-frame layout): jump rising 18 / falling 19, crouch 9, hand to hand 11, ranged 15-16, high attack 12-13-14, low attack 28-29-30. Sturm and the nomads (28 frames) and Gilthanas (37) have their own layouts, read off their sheets (not measured in the original): check them one by one.

sturm.note: low attack: the standing sword thrusts 26, 25 (frame 27 is a crouch behind the shield, it looked like a block)

nomad.note: low attack: the standing sword thrusts 26, 25 (frame 27 is a crouch behind the shield, it looked like a block)
